To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
The reasons for social media usage (SMU) are different and are related to flow, daily stress and depression symptoms.
the reasons for SMU are related to the experience of flow during usage and the experience of negative emotions.

The reasons for social media usage can be classified into five main categories, which are "Search for Information" "Search for Inspiration" "Search and Social Interaction" "Escape from Negativ Emotions" and the "Search for Positive Feelings" and that the last one is positively predicted by the experience of flow during SM usage and negatively by depression symptoms.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the reasons for social network use, the relationship of reasons for SMU with flow, daily stress and symptoms of depression and anxiety, and the relationship of flow and reasons with tendencies of addictive SM use.
the relationship of reasons for SMU, experience of flow, daily stress and depression, anxiety symptoms, and addictive SMU.
the question, what drives people to use SM and which consequences this usage has.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the use of social media is a complex phenomenon, which is influenced by a multitude of factors.
the reasons for SMU are not only a matter of individual differences but are also influenced by situational and social factors.
the reasons for SMU are diverse, but they are not equally important for the development of tendencies of addictive SM use.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
people who use SM in a flow state are less likely to experience negative emotions and therefore less likely to use SM in an addictive way.
social media use can have positive as well as negative consequences on the user.
people with more depression symptoms tend to use Facebook and Instagram for positive reasons.
The main takeaway from our work is that
SM can be used in a healthy way, but also as a way to escape from negative emotions.
the more users use SM to cope with negative emotions, the more likely they are to become addicted.
the reasons for using social media can be classified in five categories.
